subject.title: [F6] Zero-duration spans indicate missing duration instrumentation

question: Should trajectory JSONL rows gain a measured duration/start-end contract, and which requested event families should be lifecycle spans rather than point events?
rationale: Current code and docs expose trajectory records as timestamped events, so adding durations changes exported diagnostic schema and downstream support-tool expectations.

options.title: Add trajectory timing contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a focused design/fix that adds duration or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations with tests and docs.

options.title: Keep trajectory event-only
options.body: Leave trajectory JSONL as point events and document that duration analysis belongs to OTel or a separate latency report path.

options.title: Split runtime and transcript semantics
options.body: Track runtime lifecycle spans separately from transcript-derived tool call/result reconstruction so each can get the right schema.

recommendation.title: Add trajectory timing contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a focused design/fix that adds duration or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the trajectory export/runtime surface, making them the best available routing candidate for the schema decision.
